messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — kicking off a 4-arm canary tomorrow for new model bring-up (mistral-x2). Were testing two quant configs + kv-cache + prod-fallback. Need promptset prep, dedupe, golden labeling, and labeler schedule. Target: quality/regression vs prod on holdout + benchmark suite.

sam: Copy. How large is the seed/canary?

anya: Plan: 6k eval dialogs total (1.5k per arm) + 500-example golden set for focused manual review (edgecases, longctx). Use our standard longprompt + convo subsets for bench.

marta: We can cover labeling: 4 labelers x 3 days. Will need an updated golden guide 7 ncalling out new failure modes.

anya: New failure modes to highlight: long-prefetch hallucination, enum-order flips, instruction-following regressions, and truncation/paraphrase deltas between quants. Add checklist: reproducible prompt, exact model/quant tag, seed id, dedupe fingerprint.

leo: Ill run fuzzy-dedupe + deid on the seed before labels. Please run on generation output to avoid labeler churn. Example: 

```
./tools/dedupe --input canary_seed.ndjson --threshold 0.84 --out canary_dedupe_report.json
```

sam: Generating the 6k tonight. Plan: 1) identical prompts for each arm 2) capture outputs with model/quant metadata 3) attach tokenizer/latency stats. Upload path: s3://redwood-canaries/mistral-x2/1709423345/

labeler-bot: Created task LBL-4422: "Canary golden labeling (mistral-x2)" assigned to @marta + team.

marta: Got LBL-4422. Upload the post-dedupe 500 golden examples + guide. Well priority-label the 500 then sample 200 per arm for adjudication.

anya: Canary routing config were planning (low sample_rate, balanced arms):

```
canary:
  sample_rate: 0.005
  arms:
    - name: int8-baseline
      weight: 0.25
    - name: int4-optim
      weight: 0.25
    - name: int8-kvcache
      weight: 0.25
    - name: prod-fallback
      weight: 0.25
```

leo: Also adding a quick smoke metric — embedding-sim recall vs prod, flag if >5% drop. Ill push a metric job and a delta CSV of examples that changed substantially between quant variants (truncation, paraphrase, token-drop).

sam: ETA for generation + metadata: 06:00 PT. Ill post the s3 manifest when done.

anya: Please export the dedupe report + a short CSV of delta examples for labelers to triage. Upload guide & artifacts to: https://drive.redwood/inference/canary/mistral-x2/1709423345 (internal). Canary standup tomorrow 10:30 PT. :thumbsup: 

marta: :thumbsup: standing by to start labels once post-dedupe seed lands.

leo: small note — include exact tokenizer version (tokenizer-v2.1) and generation seed in metadata. Saves us a ton during repro.

anya: Will do. Thanks team.
